scientific_question: Under one inference-blind Causal-LoCoMo view and one frozen local answer backbone, how do deployable memory policies change task quality, evidence selection, harmful-memory rejection, and cost relative to no-memory and full-history controls?
estimand: For each registered method, the paired method-minus-control effect over all 87 examples and seeds 0,1,2; every example-method failure remains in the denominator.
decision_informed: Which Causal-LoCoMo implementations are eligible for a same-protocol local comparison and which upstream implementations must remain development-only because they consume evaluator-only information.

observed_development_evidence.reason: The deterministic fallback gave every method the same answer behavior and CMI selected no memories. No value from this stage may enter a local main-comparison cell.

inference_firewall.evaluator_access: The frozen evaluator may join predictions to the authoritative record by example_id only after the prediction row is durably written.

matched_protocol.failure_denominator: Each of the 1827 registered method-example-seed rows must be ACCEPTED or FAILED; missing rows are a terminal integrity failure.

method_integrity.required_overlay: Render the current task from the inference view and issue exactly one shared answer call.
Render past_sessions and current_task from the inference view; do not expose the memory-bank labels.
Replace EmbeddingRetriever._embedding's catch-all deterministic fallback with a terminal recorded embedding failure.
Summarize only content and chronology from the inference view, then use the shared answer call.

method_integrity.evidence: src/memory/reflector.py branches on memory.label == useful and harmful/poisoned before retrieval.
method_integrity.main_cell_rule: A source-fidelity real-model run is diagnostic only. It may not populate the matched main table.

method_integrity.required_overlay: Build the graph from inference-visible content and chronology only.

method_integrity.evidence: src/agents/cmi_agent.py calls score_text with the full BenchmarkExample for intervention utility and reads gold_memory_ids, bad_memory_ids and memory.label; deterministic_scorers.py reads expected_answer and other scoring criteria.
method_integrity.main_cell_rule: The upstream source-fidelity result is an oracle/development diagnostic. A blinded counterfactual proxy would be a new named method and requires a separate prospective successor before any score is observed.

outcome_branches.five_eligible_methods: After WMA release, freeze and accept one synthetic lifecycle/conformance stage for the blind, fail-closed overlay before any numerical authorization.
outcome_branches.two_blocked_methods: Record the immutable blocker in the comparison ledger. Do not fill their main cells with official, deterministic-development, oracle, or source-fidelity values.
outcome_branches.blinded_successor: If a result-independent utility/reflection proxy is designed, register it under a new method identity and freeze its formula, prompt, thresholds and controls before execution.
outcome_branches.technical_failure: Retain the full fresh root and emit FAILED rows; no in-place repair or favorable subset rerun.
outcome_branches.null_or_reversed_result: Retain and report it under the frozen paired analysis; it does not authorize changing methods, seeds, examples, or metrics.

authorization: This is a static integrity freeze only. It authorizes no server materialization, endpoint start, lifecycle execution, numerical execution, scoring, table admission, AgentEnhance execution, SOTA claim, or model cleanup while WMA Wave 1 is active.
next_allowed_gate: After the frozen WMA v3 release sequence is terminal-accepted and its services are stopped, freeze a fresh synthetic-only lifecycle package for the five eligible blind overlays and separate terminal-blocker receipts for reflection_memory and cmi.
explicitly_prohibited: passing gold behavior, scoring criteria, gold/bad/context IDs, memory label/type/expected effect, or derived label metadata to any method or answer model
using the upstream deterministic answer fallback in a real-model main cell
allowing an embedding exception to fall back to deterministic_embedding
renaming an oracle or label-aware CMI execution as a deployable matched comparison
dropping failed example-method-seed rows from the denominator
reading a completed method score before the numerical authorization is frozen
claiming superiority or SOTA from blocked, incomplete, development-only, official, or cross-protocol values
